conditions.pair_selection: seeded shuffle of eligible pairs before allocation
conditions.allocation_rule: select up to floor(cap/80) pairs; start at 80, then round-robin to capacity
conditions.synchronization: advance every pair to checkpoint before any evaluation
conditions.trial_selection: one seeded uniform recorded row per acquisition item, fixed before hooks
conditions.ungraded_rows: exclude; never treat missing outcomes as zero
conditions.exhaustion: no forced reveals; report actual count and repeat evidence if exhausted
conditions.decomposition_cells: item_id plus input (split by interactors if different)
conditions.prediction_cache: distinct full input across all pairs, reset each checkpoint
conditions.runtime: trusted in-process Python, no worker reset or timeout isolation
conditions.std_definition: population standard deviation across run-level pair means (ddof=0)

prediction_timing.scope: real full-content model.predict; excludes simulator deepcopy and coverage instrumentation
